title: Reliable Text-to-SQL in Resource-Constrained Settings with Small LLMs via Iterative Retry Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2610.17305v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently improved Text-to-SQL generation, but their computational cost can hinder deployment in resource-constrained settings. This paper evaluates the Text-to-SQL capabilities of small and medium open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) under a controlled inference budget, focusing on how model specialization and prompt formulation affect performance. Using the Spider benchmark, we compare multiple prompt representations and assess the accuracy of generated queries. Our results show that SQL-specialized models are consistently more reliable than general-purpose and chat-oriented models at small scales, and that performance can vary substantially depending on the prompt used. translated_title: 通过迭代重试工作流在资源受限环境中利用小型LLM实现可靠的Text-to-SQL
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近提升了Text-to-SQL生成的效果，但其计算成本可能阻碍在资源受限环境中的部署。本文在受控推理预算下评估了小型和中型开源LLM（1B-8B参数）的Text-to-SQL能力，重点关注模型专业化程度和提示词表述对性能的影响。基于Spider基准测试，我们比较了多种提示表示形式，并评估了生成查询的准确性。结果表明，在小规模模型下，SQL专业化模型始终比通用模型和面向对话的模型更可靠，且性能会因所使用的提示词不同而产生显著差异。为了在不依赖更大模型的情况下减少这种性能波动，我们提出了三种轻量级推理工作流，在失败发生时自动使用替代提示词和/或替代模型进行重试，其中包括一个可选的语法纠正步骤。
tldr: 该论文基于Spider基准系统评估了1B-8B参数小型开源LLM的Text-to-SQL能力，发现SQL专用小模型比通用模型更可靠，并提出三种失败时自动更换提示词或模型重试的轻量级迭代工作流，从而在资源受限环境中显著提升Text-to-SQL生成的稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates small open-source LLMs (1B-8B parameters) on Text-to-SQL using the Spider benchmark, showing that SQL-specialized models are more reliable than general-purpose ones, and introduces three lightweight iterative retry workflows that automatically switch prompts or models upon failure to improve Text-to-SQL reliability in resource-constrained settings.
